question: Should OpenClaw own static Codex model price snapshots in the bundled fallback catalog for this fix?
rationale: Those defaults change upgrade-visible cost totals and can drift from provider pricing; code inspection can verify the mechanics but not the product ownership decision.

options.title: Accept static Codex prices
options.body: Merge after rebase if a maintainer explicitly accepts the price table and its update burden.

options.title: Resolver only
options.body: Keep the generated-zero handling but remove static Codex prices so unknown pricing stays reported as missing unless configured.

options.title: Pause pricing ownership
options.body: Hold or split the PR until Codex pricing ownership is decided separately.

recommendation.title: Accept static Codex prices
recommendation.body: Merge after rebase if a maintainer explicitly accepts the price table and its update burden.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent Codex provider identity and fallback catalog history most directly implicated by this decision.
